title: "Configuration"

# Configuration {#sec-configuration}

All settings register with `CBA_fnc_addSetting` and appear in the CBA Settings menu under the **AEE** categories. Values marked *global* must match across all clients.

## AEE

| Setting | Type | Default | Addon | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_enabled` | CHECKBOX | `true` | core | Master switch for the AEE environment simulation module |
| `aee_core_updateInterval` | SLIDER | `5` | core | Simulation update interval in seconds (lower = more frequent updates) |
| `aee_core_referenceAltitude` | SLIDER | `0` | core | Override reference altitude (m MSL) for station pressure calculations. 0 = auto-detect from unit position |
| `aee_core_clothingInsulation` | SLIDER | `1.0` | core | Multiplier for clothing insulation. Higher values keep the soldier warmer in cold conditions |
| `aee_core_diagnostic` | CHECKBOX | `false` | core | Enable verbose diagnostic logging (diag_log) for environment state changes |

## AEE Real Weather

This category registers only when the mission provides a `weather.json`
file. With no file present, the setting does not appear — matching the
host-mod visibility rule for the other compat addons.

| Setting | Type | Default | Addon | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_compat_realweather_enabled` | CHECKBOX | `false` | compat_realweather | Enable real-weather mode. Reads weather.json from the mission folder and overrides AEE's simulated state. |

| `aee_core_precipOrographicEnabled` | CHECKBOX | `true` | core | Enable orographic-lifting precipitation enhancement on windward slopes |
| `aee_core_airDensityEnabled` | CHECKBOX | `true` | core | Calculate density altitude and true air density using temperature, pressure, and humidity corrections |
